text: Artificial intelligence is transforming our world, but it also brings important ethical challenges. One major concern is bias, since AI systems learn from data that may contain human prejudices. If not addressed, this can lead to unfair outcomes in areas like hiring, lending, or even healthcare. Fairness means actively checking algorithms to ensure they treat all people equally. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often collects massive amounts of personal information, so strict rules are needed to protect users. Transparency is equally vital—people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development requires companies and governments to work together, testing systems thoroughly and creating clear guidelines before releasing them into daily life.
